messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

Your BC04 is on its way, Neelesh. It left our Brampton warehouse on October 19, heading to (address hidden).

Tracking: (tracking link hidden)

The Miner Duster on that order is still waiting on stock, so it follows in its own parcel at no cost once the next batch lands. You can watch that batch come in here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Anything else you want me to check?
can  you delay shipping on this order or delay delivery date?

That one's already gone, Neelesh. The B.04 was labelled and left Brampton on October 19, so I can't hold it back from here. Once the tracking shows movement, ShipBob's carrier can usually hold it at a depot or pickup point if you request it on the tracking page.

The Miner Duster hasn't shipped yet, so I can hold that one for a date you choose.

Is there a date you need delivery after, or an address issue? Tell me and I'll work around it.
no that's ok leave all as is.

Will do, Neelesh, everything stays as it is.

Before you go, one thing: back in September you asked twice to cancel the B30. What made you decide to stay with it?

I was quite excited for the product but disappointed that delivery timelines were not met on multiple occasions.  I knew these units were constructed as orders came in but a firm delivery date remained elusive given your complex supply chain.  Going forwards, I guess any estimated delivery date is merely an optimistic suggestion?

That's fair, and I won't dress it up. On pre-sale units the date is the manufacturer's build and shipping plan, and when that moves, our date moves with it. In-stock items are firm; pre-orders are a best current date, not a guarantee, and we should say which one you're looking at every time.

One more thing, if you don't mind: would you rather we hold back a date until the batch physically ships, or keep giving you the working date even when it slips?

I do like the working date but please emphasize its a working date and also please quickly update the status of where the unit is.  If there's a delay, it's at least nice to know at what stage of production/delivery the unit is in.

Noted, and that's useful. The stage view already exists for incoming batches at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status, it shows where a batch is: in production, shipped from the factory, in transit, checking in at the warehouse. I'll share your point about labelling it clearly as a working date with the team.

Your BC04 is in transit, the Duster follows when the next batch lands. Enjoy the unit, Neelesh.
btw can I find this link from the main website?

Honestly, I'd just bookmark the link. It's a real page on our site, but I can't promise it's linked from the main menu, so searching for it isn't reliable. Save https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status and you'll always land straight on it.
